description: Multi-Client Email Authorization Gate, Public Guest PII Security Layer, Direct Email Delivery, and Admin Download Audit Logs with CSV Export

features: Two-tier access gate: Authorized Client OTP & Public Guest Verified Gate
Public Guest security layer collecting Full Name, Email, Phone, Organization, and Reason for Download
Direct delivery notification: informs users of instant high-res ZIP stream and inbox delivery
Removal of Frame # badges and alt tags across all photo assets
Hallmark-styled glassmorphism modal with accessible keyboard focus and live feedback toasts
Multi-email regex matching supporting comma-separated authorized emails
Tier 2 (Public Guest): PII, organization, and download reason requirement + 6-digit email confirmation code
Automatic background dispatch of high-res download delivery email via FalhenSMTPMailer
Full audit trail logging to client_download_logs and JSONL fallback stream
Comma-separated client email support in Edit Gallery form with syntax sanitization
Dedicated Download Access & Audit Logs subview tab in Admin Client Galleries
Batch filtering by Client Gallery, Access Tier, and Requestor Search
KPI metrics cards: Total Downloads, Authorized Clients, Public Guests, and Email Deliveries
Full-featured CSV Export for download logs with batch and tier filtering
